mapper.select: SELECT no, board_no, parent_no, depth, content, writer, TO_CHAR(reg_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS reg_date FROM project_reply WHERE board_no = #{boardNo} ORDER BY no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_reply (no, board_no, parent_no, depth, content, writer, reg_date) VALUES (seq_project_reply_no.nextval, #{boardNo}, 0, 0, #{content}, #{writer}, sysdate)
INSERT INTO project_reply (no, board_no, parent_no, depth, content, writer, reg_date) VALUES (seq_project_reply_no.nextval, #{boardNo}, #{parentNo}, #{depth}, #{content}, #{writer}, sysdate)
mapper.update: UPDATE project_reply SET content = #{content} WHERE no = #{no}
